newsitem.title: UK: South West Water in $15.5 mln U.S. purchase.
newsitem.headline: South West Water in $15.5 mln U.S. purchase.

text.p: Britain's South West Water Plc on Thursday it bought private U.S.-based company Hydrolab for $15.5 million in cash.
Hydrolab is a manufacturer and supplier of "multi-parameter, water quality monitoring instruments," South West Water said in a statement.

It said Hydrolab would become part of and strengthen the company's ELE Group, its specialist environmental instrumentation business which trades in over 100 countries and contributed 3.7 million stg to pre-tax profits in 1996/97.
The acquisition is projected to enhance earnings from 1998/99.

"This acquisition continues our successful focused strategy of building an international instrumentation business," said Colin Drummond, managing director of South West Water's Enterprise division in a statement.
